assumptions.statement: The site and three key areas use street-aligned provisional polygons reused with attribution from public Issue #846; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All design layers, areas, ratios, figures and PDFs must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Receipt of official or rights-cleared CAD/GIS/PDF boundary with CRS and version metadata.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, coverage, setbacks, land parcels and statutory land-use controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity and parcel-level actions remain methods and conceptual recommendations, not approved controls.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, rail interfaces, parking supply and traffic counts are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All cross-links and station interfaces are conceptual alignments requiring transport, accessibility and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, uses, ages, heights, structural conditions and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are reversible design prototypes only; no demolition, retention or construction decision is made.

assumptions.statement: The heritage park and protected-site control boundaries are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks and green-space interfaces must remain lightweight and reversible until heritage review is complete.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, fire, power and compute-capacity data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge-compute and low-carbon infrastructure are service concepts, not engineering commitments.
